sections.title: Loading placeholder box
sections.what: Draws a gray box that pulses to show that content is still loading. The caller sets its size and shape by passing a class name.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the page layout steady while data arrives, so content does not jump into place.

summary: A gray, gently pulsing placeholder box that stands in for content while it is loading.
purpose: Shows a loading shape so the screen does not look empty while data arrives.
why: Likely reason: prevents an empty-looking screen while data loads. The code does not state this.
how: It receives an optional class name for size and position, merges it with its own pulsing gray style, and renders one empty box.
inputs: An optional className string from the parent component.
outputs: One styled empty box on screen.
risks: Low. The box has no default size, so a parent that gives no size can make it invisible.
debug: If the placeholder does not appear, check that the parent passes a className that sets width and height. If it looks wrong in dark mode, check the dark color classes.
